chapter_seo_title: Blades of Heaven: Ji Ning’s Second True Body Erases Three Demon Kings
chapter_meta_description: Cornered by eleven demon kings, Ji Ning unleashes his greatest weapon—a late-Void second true body wielding the Plow the Heavens Sword Formation. The tables turn fast.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 381 – Plow the Heavens
og_description: Ji Ning springs a devastating ambush within an ambush, using his second true body to tear three demon kings apart in seconds.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 381 – Plow the Heavens
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s second true body drops like a hammer: three demon kings dead in a single sword-art.

lore_anchors.definition: An independent clone cultivated from a Primal soul; can train separately and fight simultaneously with the main body, acting as a devastating trump card.
A Daofather-created sword-art that carves black gashes into the sky itself, treating space as a field to be plowed.
Ji Ning's Immortal-ranked sword whose power rivals a Pure Yang treasure; he deliberately suppressed its might earlier in the fight to mislead the enemy.
The leader of the twelve demon kings, whose combat power matches a Celestial Immortal; uses a set of ninety-nine spherical Immortal-ranked treasures.
The demon king killed in the previous chapter's ambush; he was the 'wing nexus' of the Flying Bear Grand Formation, without whom the formation cannot function.
